verification_candidates.claim_text: Using stimulant drugs taxes the adrenal glands into producing more cortisol until they fail, leaving a low-cortisol state of all-day fatigue.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: you're going to start taxing your adrenals to pump out more cortisol and eventually they will fail
verification_candidates.rationale: A central physiological harm claim about stimulants and adrenal failure that listeners would act on.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Stimulants disturb your blood sugar.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: It's also going to start messing with your blood sugar.
verification_candidates.rationale: A checkable metabolic effect attributed to stimulants.

verification_candidates.claim_text: People who need Adderall to function are physically addicted to a stimulant to get through the day.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: your body is literally addicted to a stimulant to just get through your day
verification_candidates.rationale: A dependence claim about a prescribed medication that could change whether listeners keep taking it.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Weaning off stimulants brings a period of deep exhaustion and fatigue that is necessary to reset the system.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: You're going to go through some deep exhaustion, some bad fatigue times, but you have to to reset your system.
verification_candidates.rationale: A claim about what stopping a prescribed stimulant does, which listeners might act on without medical advice.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Continued stimulant use eventually taxes the cardiovascular system.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: eventually it's going to start taxing your cardiovascular system
verification_candidates.rationale: A cardiovascular harm claim about stimulants that can be checked.

verification_candidates.claim_text: When the adrenals stop producing proper amounts of cortisol they steal progesterone and pregnenolone to make cortisol, so those hormones drop.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: they start stealing progesterone and pregnenolone to make the cortisol
verification_candidates.rationale: A specific hormonal mechanism that can be checked against endocrinology.

verification_candidates.claim_text: You cannot take T3 when your cortisol is very low because adding T3 then causes heart palpitations and anxiety.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: You actually get heart palpitations and anxiety when you add in T3.
verification_candidates.rationale: A specific drug-safety claim about thyroid hormone that could change treatment decisions.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Low cortisol is normally caused by taxed adrenals from prolonged stress and stimulants rather than by disease.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: Normally, when we see low cortisol, it's from what I just talked about.
verification_candidates.rationale: A prevalence claim about the usual cause of low cortisol that can be checked.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Addison's disease is a rare, diagnosable autoimmune disorder in which the adrenal glands do not produce enough cortisol.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: Addison's is an actual disorder, a diagnosable disorder that occurs when the adrenal glands just they don't produce enough cortisol
verification_candidates.rationale: A checkable description and prevalence statement about a named disease.

verification_candidates.claim_text: The T2 thyroid fixer supplement works at the mitochondrial level to raise cellular ATP energy.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: how it actually works at the mitochondrial level to kick up those cells a notch, to kick up the cellular energy of ATP
verification_candidates.rationale: A mechanism claim for a product the host sells, checkable against evidence.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Low ATP production causes a low metabolism, and raising ATP gives more energy and vitality.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: If you have low ATP production, you're going to have a low metabolism.
verification_candidates.rationale: A causal link between cellular energy and metabolism that can be checked.

verification_candidates.claim_text: There is not really a way to test your ATP production.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: there's not really a way to test that
verification_candidates.rationale: A checkable claim about whether a laboratory test exists.

verification_candidates.claim_text: CoQ10 and L-carnitine supplements improve mitochondrial function.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: There are other supplements that you can add in to improve mitochondrial function.
verification_candidates.rationale: A supplement benefit claim listeners would act on.

verification_candidates.claim_text: NADH is the active ingredient in Young Goose skincare products, and NAD+ can also be taken as an injectable peptide.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: That's what's in Young Goose Skin Care products, but you can also take NAD plus as an injectable peptide.
verification_candidates.rationale: A checkable composition and route-of-administration claim.

verification_candidates.claim_text: You may not be able to absorb or make NAD from taking an NAD supplement.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: you can't really absorb or make NAD from... taking a supplement
verification_candidates.rationale: A contested absorption claim about a popular supplement class.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Drinking energy drinks every day is harmful, while a couple of cups of coffee is fine.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: a couple cups of coffee is fine
verification_candidates.rationale: A safety threshold for caffeine intake that listeners would act on.
